title: Fix Print Paragraph Text Overshoot And Hyphenation
description: In the zwischenbericht "Tragwerksplanung" paragraph (section 1.2.1.2.2.3), text overshoots the right edge of the window box border — the appendix cross-reference "Anhang I.TW" (rendered via \appendixref) sticks out past the right margin instead of wrapping or hyphenating correctly. Investigate the print LaTeX pipeline (semio-window.sty tcolorbox text width, \appendixref's \nobreakspace glue, babel/microtype hyphenation settings) to find the root cause and fix it so justified paragraph text never overshoots the window border, with correct German hyphenation.
summary:
Root cause: TeX only hyphenates a run of letters that is itself preceded by a glue node. A word right at the very start of a paragraph/cell has no such glue (fixed generically already by the `\hspace{0pt}` prefix baked into semio-table.sty's p-column preamble), but a slash-joined compound like "Wand-/Scheibenelement" breaks cleanly at the literal hyphen and then leaves "/Scheibenelement" glued directly to the "/" with still no preceding glue — so pattern hyphenation never resumes on the second half, and the whole remainder overflows the narrow "Typologie" column into "Beispiele". Reproduced and confirmed in isolation with tectonic/babel/ngerman (bare "Scheibenelement" at a cell start overflows; adding `\hspace{0pt}` first fixes it; "Wand-/Scheibenelement" overflows on the "/Scheibenelement" remainder specifically, fixed by inserting `\hspace{0pt}` right after the slash).

Fix: added a reusable `\SemioSlash` macro to print/tex/semio-core.sty (Hyphenation Safety region) that expands to `/\hspace{0pt}`, restoring the missing glue after the slash. Replaced the 8 occurrences of "X-/Y" typology labels in mit-bestand/bericht/zwischenbericht/anhang/typologie.tex with "X-\SemioSlash{}Y". Rebuilt the zwischenbericht and confirmed via rendered page 60 that "Wand-/Scheibenelement", "Lokales Knoten-/Übergangselement", and "Mehrgliedriges Knoten-/Übergangselement" now hyphenate correctly and stay inside the Typologie column; all Overfull hbox warnings in that table section are gone (log count dropped from 86 to 79 overall, zero remaining in the typologie.tex range).
